items.title: 3 Manufacturing Stocks That Could Benefit If Tariffs Push Production Closer To Home
items.summary: Tariffs are back in the headlines, with the U.S. floating new duties of up to 20% or more on imports from China, the EU, and a long list of manufacturing hubs. That kind of shake up can hurt some global production chains and redirect others closer to home. Investors watching this shift toward U.S., Mexico, and Canada factories may find fresh ideas.
